_comment: Harmonizes coded categorical values that differ across dumps (e.g. early files use codes like 'AS', later ones spell out 'Academic Staff'). Keys are canonical fields; values map a raw value (matched case-insensitively, trimmed) to a normalized label. Unmapped values are kept as-is. Edit freely as you spot new codes in the Data Health page.
_school_comment: Division renames. The source rewrote its division vocabulary between the Apr 2025 and Sep 2025 records requests: 20 names retired, 34 appeared, and 61% of the Apr 2025 rows ended up under a name that no longer exists — which severs every division time series at that boundary. Keys are the retired name, values the name in use now. A pair belongs here only when the two names are the same unit: at least 85% of the people under the old name reappear under the new one in the next snapshot, or the names match once case and punctuation are stripped. Three divisions that lost their names fail that test and are deliberately absent because they reorganized rather than renamed — General Services (27% to Office of Human Resources), Division of Student Life (66%), General Educational Admin (51%); aliasing those would invent history. `npm run data` reports any division that disappears between snapshots, with where its people went, so the next rename shows up as build output.

school.Sch of Med & Public Health: School of Medicine and Public Health
school.College of Ag & Life Science: College of Agricultural and Life Sciences
school.VC for Rsrch & Grad Education: Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research
school.Associate Vice Chancellor for Identity a: Associate Vice Chancellor for Student Success and Belonging
